text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally need human intelligence, such as understanding language, recognising images, or making decisions. Machine learning is a part of AI where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning, a more advanced form, uses large artificial neural networks to find patterns in huge amounts of information. AI is already part of our daily lives. For example, it helps us unlock phones with our faces, suggests films on streaming services, powers voice assistants like Siri, and guides us through maps. It is also used in hospitals and online shopping.
